node.title: L1 tame fixed-petal refinement census
node.statement: Fix one maximal source with M_src disjoint ell-point petals. For s|ell, put r=ell/s. If a monic degree-s quotient polynomial partitions one whole source petal into complete s-point level fibers, then its locator is F(P), with F monic split squarefree of degree r. When the field characteristic does not divide r, the top s-1 coefficients of F(P) recursively determine every nonconstant lower coefficient of P; its constant is exactly additive-shift freedom. Hence each petal carries at most one degree-s refinement class and all tame classes number at most M_src tau(ell)<=n. This counts maps only: small-scale fiber-role payment, wild divisors, unanchored maps, growing polarity, and arbitrary locators remain open. The exact F_9 decomposition of X^9-X into four inequivalent normalized cubic right components proves the tame guard cannot be removed by coefficient triangularity alone, but is not asserted to be an admissible-domain counterexample.
